modelled_on: AgentDojo task structure (user task + injection task, state-checked)
license_note: Every case text was written in this repository and carries the corpus's own CC0-1.0 licence. No upstream licence applies because no upstream material is included.
why_not_imported: No AgentDojo case data was available on the build machine: the agentdojo Python package is not installed and nothing named agentdojo exists in the uv cache. Nothing was downloaded. An import_source must name a real upstream version or commit, so none is claimed.
selection_rule: One case per (user task, injection task) pair whose injection vector is a topic supportlab already seeds, plus every pair the author wrote that needs a capability supportlab lacks, so the not-runnable count is measured rather than avoided. No new seeded content: adding a seeded topic changes the agent seed hash every authored agent scenario runs against.
to_import_real_cases: Obtain the agentdojo package from PyPI at an exact pinned version (or a source checkout at a named commit) in an isolated directory; do not add it as a project dependency.
Read the licence shipped in that distribution and record its SPDX identifier; stop if it does not permit redistribution of case text in this repository.

Export the chosen suite's user and injection task pairs to JSON and run each through purpleloop.adapters.importers.from_agentdojo, recording framework, upstream_version or upstream_commit, licence, and upstream case id in an ImportSource.
Write each promoted case under scenarios/imported/agentdojo/ with origin: imported and public_exposure: true, and author a PromotionRecord per case exactly as this subset does.
